about_the_game:
Whisker’s Tale

A Cozy Cat Adventure About Friendship, Curiosity, and Finding Home.

Step into the paws of Luna, a curious little cat living in a charming European-inspired city. From the bustle of the Market Square to the quiet corners of the Library Courtyard, every street hides small adventures, simple puzzles, and warm stories waiting to be uncovered.

Run errands for your loving owner, help townsfolk with their troubles, and explore rooftops, docks, and plazas — all through the eyes of a cat. Push crates, knock over bread rolls, carry flowers, chase pigeons, and curl up for a nap under the sun as you uncover the gentle rhythm of city life.

But when a misunderstood dog causes chaos during the city’s big Festival, it’s up to you and your new friends to bring everyone together again.

✨ Features

Play as a cat – Walk, run, jump, climb, paw at objects, and purr your way through a hand-crafted city.
Explore cozy districts – From bakery rooftops to riverside docks, each area tells its own story.

Meet colourful characters – Your owner, a playful street kitten, a wise library cat, and a dog who might not be as scary as he seems.

Solve light puzzles – Fetch, push, climb, and chase in short, satisfying errands.

Live the small moments – Nap in the bakery, listen to violinists under the stars, and watch fireworks from the rooftops.

Collect yarn balls and discover secret nap spots hidden throughout the city.

A Whisker’s Tale is a love letter to curiosity, kindness, and the quiet stories that unfold when you slow down and explore.
